finding: The scene source has no reduced-motion branch or switch. Its construct() path calls self.play 14 times, including 7 working-node pulse pairs at 0.12 seconds per leg, so a reduced-motion preference cannot be honored at the scene level.

candidate_change.scope: candidate only; do not edit production files in this proposal
candidate_change.proposal: Add one explicit HERAKLES_REDUCED_MOTION=1 scene flag and route every reveal/create/write animation through a small helper. In reduced mode, add the same final mobjects directly instead of playing transitions, and skip the repeated node scale/opacity pulse loop; keep labels, counts, receipt, footer, and final hold visible. Preserve the current timing and pulse behavior when the flag is unset.
acceptance: Reduced mode has no repeated pulse animation and no perceptible transition sequence.
Reduced mode preserves the same source-bound text, counts, objects, and final receipt state.

evidence.measurement: rg found 14 self.play calls; the pulse loop applies two 0.12-second animations to pulses[:7], and the scene ends with self.wait(1.0).
Case-insensitive search for reduced-motion, prefers-reduced-motion, and HERAKLES_REDUCED_MOTION returned no matches.
The supplied snapshot declares fake_evidence=false and permits only agent id, model family, status, restart count, and aggregate counts; no extra source data was used.
The supplied path does not exist in the workspace, so duration, frame cadence, and visual playback QA were not measured.

falsifier: A read-only inspection or test render that finds a documented, wired reduced-motion switch already intercepting all scene animations and suppressing the 7 pulse pairs while preserving the final scene would falsify this finding.
next_measurement: In an isolated candidate branch, render once with the flag unset and once with HERAKLES_REDUCED_MOTION=1. Compare frame-to-frame differences and final-frame object/text presence; require reduced mode to omit pulse/transition changes while retaining all labels, counts, task parcels, receipt, and footer.
